title: Food delivery system design
idea: A food delivery design models the order as a state machine, and lets the customer app, restaurant and dispatcher subscribe to its status changes.
points: `Order` moves through fixed states and only ever one step forward.
Each status change notifies subscribers: the Observer pattern.
The dispatcher claims an agent while food cooks, and frees them on delivery.

steps.caption: The customer places the order. `Order` starts in `PLACED` and holds the item list.
The restaurant accepts. Every subscriber is told, so the app shows the new status.
Cooking starts. The dispatcher hears `PREPARING` and claims a free agent now, not after cooking.
No agent free? The order still cooks; the dispatcher must retry or queue it.
The agent picks the food up. Status moves to `PICKED_UP` and the customer can track it.
Delivered. The dispatcher returns the agent to the pool. Further `advance` calls throw.

code.title: Order states and observers
code.caption: One agent, one order. Subscribe a `restaurant` watcher that logs only `PICKED_UP`, and run it again.

walk.text: The legal path is one ordered list, so states cannot be skipped or reversed.
`advance` moves one step, then calls every subscriber with the order.
The pool hands out free agents and takes them back. Empty means `null`.
The dispatcher is just another observer. `onChange` is an arrow field so `this` survives being passed.
Two subscribers: the customer view and the dispatcher.
A finished order refuses to move, and Kim is back in the pool.

pitfalls: Do not call SMS or dispatch code inside `Order`; publish a change and let observers act.
Handle `assign()` returning `null`; peak hours run out of agents.
Do not let any caller set `status` directly; one method must guard transitions.

quiz.why: The loop calls each watcher in the order it was added, and both push. Observers run in subscription order.

takeaway: The order owns its states; everyone else subscribes and reacts.

starters: How would I add order cancellation and refunds to this state machine?
Which strategy should pick the delivery agent for an order?
Should observers run synchronously or through a message queue?
